detail.longDescription: You will note that I am placing these posts under a hashtag for those who are not interested. So I said to # ChatGPT -6 Astra: This is the Team-FM Listen Again page. Edit the page and review the code I have prepared. It follows a specific pattern so remember this for next time so as to add future shows without my explaining the procedure again. The page contains links to archived radio shows for later listening. Add Welcome to the Weekend for 4 September 2026 using the prescribed format and save the changes. My prompt was more structured than that but that was the general idea. That task took 35 seconds, so it is definitely faster than before.
